title: Meta Connect 2025 Developer Keynote
summary: Concept, visual narrative, and deck design for Meta's 2025 developer keynote.
overview: Selected to lead the design flow for the full Meta Connect 2025 developer keynote after starting with concept work for one speaker section. The engagement expanded across concept development, narrative structure, storyboarding, motion direction, deck design, and cross-functional production alignment.
